name: Shiprocket Limited
summary: Shiprocket Limited provides e-commerce enablement platform solutions in India. It offers Shiprocket Shipping, an e-commerce shipping platform that automates workflows across sales channels; ShiprocketX, an end-to-end cross border solution; fastrr, AI native growth suite for commerce brands; Shiprocket Fulfillment, a warehousing, and packaging and shipping solution; Shiprocket Trends; and Shiprocket Capital, a revenue-based financing platform. The company also provides Shiprocket Packaging for packaging solutions; Shiprocket Cargo, a platform that offers end-to-end logistics partner for domestic freight movement; Shiprocket Omuni, an unified commerce platform; Shiprocket Promise for shopping;…
